item.title: China Assembles Orbital Datacenter Pieces: In-Orbit AI, Cloud-Native Sats and 100Gbps Laser Links
item.description: A September 23 synthesis of recent launches and tests describes China lofting the building blocks of an orbital datacenter—on-board AI compute, cloud-native satellite software and 100 Gbps-class laser links—across several parallel programs.

item.title: Inspur MetaBrain SD200 Ultra Packs 128 Domestic AI Chips for 2.8T Kimi K3 Under 5.85ms/Token
item.description: At AICC2026, Inspur Information launched the MetaBrain SD200 Ultra supernode with 128 tightly coupled domestic AI chips, 8 TB of unified accelerator memory and a claimed sub-5.85 ms/token latency running 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3.

item.title: Li Auto Ships Embodied Trilogy: ME-Brain-1.0, ME-U0 Unified WAM and Edge ME-VLM
item.description: Li Auto's Foundation Model team released ME-Brain-1.0, the ME-U0 unified world-action model and ME-VLM cognitive models (35B-A3B plus a 4B edge SKU on the M100 SoC), emphasizing system architecture over vehicle branding.

item.title: China Telecom Open-Sources Xing4.0-29B-A4B Agentic MoE Trained End-to-End on Ascend
item.description: China Telecom AI released Xing4.0-29B-A4B, a 29B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 4B active parameters and 256K context, trained end-to-end on Ascend NPUs with MindSpore and published with open weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

item.title: T-Head Unveils Zhenwu V900 AI Accelerator: About 3× M890, 216GB Memory, Q1 2027 Mass Production
item.description: At Apsara 2026, Alibaba's T-Head introduced the Zhenwu V900 training and inference accelerator with about three times M890 performance, 216 GB of memory and 1,200 GB/s chip-to-chip bandwidth, targeting mass production in the first quarter of 2027.

item.title: 🔬 An Oscar, Two Asteroids, and the Algorithm in Your sklearn: John Platt on AI for Science
item.description: We talked to Google’s Oscar winning “Giganerd” about automating science, solving climate change, and how future generations can contribute to science in the age of superintelligent AI
